items.title: Shaping the future of dermatology care through collaboration and shared decision making
items.summary: I have worked within the NHS for more than 40 years. Throughout my career I have seen dermatology care evolve considerably.

items.title: Skin Analytics wins £50k West Suffolk contract for AI skin cancer triage
items.summary: West Suffolk NHS Foundation Trust has awarded Skin Analytics Ltd a £50,000 contract to run its DERM AI skin cancer assessment service at West Suffolk Hospital.

items.title: NHS England South East region rolls out AI skin cancer checks in the largest deployment of autonomous medical AI in NHS history
items.summary: NHSE South East’s rollout of Skin Analytics’ AI technology, DERM, puts the government's 10-year health plan into practice, giving a further 9 million people access to faster skin cancer screening.

items.title: BBC reports – the clinic using AI to detect skin cancer earlier
items.summary: Staff at an NHS clinic using artificial intelligence (AI) to detect skin cancer sooner have said the technology could be a "game changer".

items.title: NHS study: AI skin cancer technology frees up 62% more dermatologist capacity
items.summary: Research and evaluation by Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trusts finds that Skin Analytics’ AI medical device DERM safely discharges over a quarter of urgent skin cancer referrals without a face-to-face appointment and offers a 62% gain in clinical capacity.

items.title: Skin Analytics on Scaling Europe
items.summary: Neil Daly, Skin Analytics CEO, joins Seb Johnson on Scaling Europe to talk about DERM Zero, and twelve years spent building towards this.
